newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Petron to study new refinery project.
newsitem.headline: Petron to study new refinery project.

text.p: Petron Corp said on Monday it had been given a $350,000 grant to conduct the feasibility and the basic design for a new refinery and a petrochemical project.
The grant was extended by the United States Trade and Development Agency.

"The feasibility study will enable Petron to develop a master plan for the expansion of its existing refining business to meet the growing demand for its products. It will also establish a basis for Petron's diversification to other related businesses particularly in petrochemicals," Petron said in a statement.
Petron presently has crude distillation capacity of 165,000 barrels per day. It plans to increase its capacity to 180,000 barrels per day.
